breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between the time domain `t in [0, 1.0]` and the requested final time `T=1.1`. The generated specification includes both contradictory values (`Time domain t ∈ [0, 1.0]` and `Final solution time T = 1.1`). The ground truth resolves this by changing the final time to `T=1.0` to match the domain.
